the FORGE directory path (~/.forge).\nfn get_forge_dir() -> std::path::PathBuf {\n    dirs::home_dir()\n        .expect(\"Could not determine home directory\")\n        .join(\".forge\")\n}\n\n/// Run the onboarding flow.\n///\n/// # Arguments\n///\n/// * `non_interactive` - If true, suppress output and auto-select backend\n/// * `preferred_backend` - Optional backend to use (from FORGE_CHAT_BACKEND env var)\nfn run_onboarding(\n    non_interactive: bool,\n    preferred_backend: Option<&str>,\n) -> Result<(), Box<dyn std::error::Error>> {\n    info!(\n        \"Starting onboarding flow (non_interactive={}, preferred_backend={:?})\",\n        non_interactive, preferred_backend\n    );\n\n    // Detect CLI tools with diagnostics\n    if !non_interactive {\n        eprintln!(\"🔍 Detecting available CLI tools...\");\n    }\n    let (tools, diagnostics) = detection::detect_cli_tools_with_diagnostics()?;\n\n    // Filter to only show tools that are ready to use\n    let ready_tools: Vec<_> = tools.iter().filter(|t| t.is_ready()).collect();\n\n    if ready_tools.is_empty() {\n        // Use the guidance module to show detailed instructions (both interactive and non-interactive)\n        eprint!(\"{}\", guidance::generate_guidance(Some(&diagnostics)));\n        return Err(\"No compatible CLI tools available\".into());\n    }\n\n    // Select the backend to use\n    let selected_tool: detection::CliToolDetection = if let Some(backend) = preferred_backend {\n        // Try to find the specified backend\n        let normalized_backend = normalize_backend_name(backend);\n        let found = tools.iter().find(|t| {\n            let tool_name = normalize_backend_name(&t.name);\n            tool_name == normalized_backend\n        });\n\n        match found {\n            Some(tool) => {\n                if !tool.is_ready() {\n                    eprintln!(\n                        \"error: Backend '{}' is not ready: {}\",\n                        backend,\n                        tool.status_message()\n                    );\n                    if tool.status == detection::ToolStatus::MissingApiKey\n                        && let Some(env_var) = &tool.api_key_env_var\n                    {\n                        eprintln!(\"Set the {} environment variable and try again\", env_var);\n                    }\n                    return Err(format!(\"Backend '{}' is not ready\", backend).into());\n                }\n                tool.clone()\n            }\n            None => {\n                eprintln!(\"error: Backend '{}' not found\", backend);\n                eprintln!(\n                    \"Available backends: {}\",\n                    tools\n                        .iter()\n                        .map(|t| t.name.as_str())\n                        .collect::<Vec<_>>()\n                        .join(\", \")\n                );\n                return Err(format!(\"Backend '{}' not found\", backend).into());\n            }\n        }\n    } else if non_interactive {\n        // Auto-select the first ready tool in non-interactive mode\n        match tools.iter().find(|t| t.is_ready()) {\n            Some(tool) => tool.clone(),\n            None => {\n                // Tools exist but none are ready - show specific guidance\n                let not_ready: Vec<_> = tools\n                    .iter()\n                    .filter(|t| !t.is_ready())\n                    .map(|t| {\n                        let (missing_api_key, incompatible_version, missing_feature) = match t.status {\n                            detection::ToolStatus::MissingApiKey => (true, false, None),\n                            detection::ToolStatus::IncompatibleVersion => {\n                                // Extract missing feature from diagnostics\n                                let feature = diagnostics\n                                    .rejections\n                                    .iter()\n                                    .find(|r| r.tool_name == t.name || r.tool_name == t.name.replace(\"-code\", \"\"))\n                                    .and_then(|r| match &r.reason {\n                                        guidance::RejectionReason::IncompatibleVersion { missing_feature, .. } => {\n                                            Some(missing_feature.clone())\n                                        }\n                                        _ => None,\n                                    });\n                                (false, true, feature)\n                            }\n                            _ => (false, false, None),\n                        };\n                        guidance::ToolFixInfo {\n                            name: t.name.clone(),\n                            version: t.version.clone(),\n                            missing_api_key,\n                            api_key_env_var: t.api_key_env_var.clone(),\n                            incompatible_version,\n                            missing_feature,\n                        }\n                    })\n                    .collect();\n\n                if !not_ready.is_empty() {\n                    eprint!(\"{}\", guidance::generate_not_ready_guidance(&not_ready));\n                }\n                return Err(\"No ready tools available\".into());\n            }\n        }\n    } else {\n        // Interactive mode: show the TUI wizard for selection\n        match wizard::run_wizard(tools.clone()) {\n            Ok(Some(tool)) => {\n                // User selected a tool\n                eprintln!(\n                    \"\\n✨ Using: {} ({})\",\n                    tool.name,\n                    tool.binary_path.display()\n                );\n                tool\n            }\n            Ok(None) => {\n                // User chose \"Manual Setup\" - skip auto-configuration\n                eprintln!(\"\\n📝 Manual setup selected.\");\n                eprintln!(\"   Create ~/.forge/config.yaml manually to configure FORGE.\");\n                return Ok(());\n            }\n            Err(wizard::WizardError::UserCancelled) => {\n                eprintln!(\"\\n👋 Setup cancelled.\");\n                return Err(\"User cancelled setup\".into());\n            }\n            Err(wizard::WizardError::NoToolsAvailable) => {\n                // This shouldn't happen since we already checked, but handle it\n                eprint!(\"{}\", guidance::generate_guidance(Some(&diagnostics)));\n                return Err(\"No compatible CLI tools available\".into());\n            }\n            Err(e) => {\n                eprintln!(\"\\nerror: Wizard failed: {}\", e);\n                return Err(format!(\"Wizard failed: {}\", e).into());\n            }\n        }\n    };\n\n    if non_interactive {\n        // Only print in non-interactive mode (wizard already prints in interactive mode)\n        info!(\n            \"Auto-selected: {} ({})\",\n            selected_tool.name,\n            selected_tool.binary_path.display()\n        );\n    }\n\n    // Create directory structure\n    let forge_dir = get_forge_dir();\n    if !non_interactive {\n        eprintln!(\"\\n📁 Creating directory structure...\");\n    }\n    generator::create_directory_structure(&forge_dir)?;\n\n    // Generate config.yaml\n    let config_path = forge_dir.join(\"config.yaml\");\n    if !non_interactive {\n        eprintln!(\"📝 Generating config.yaml...\");\n    }\n    generator::generate_config_yaml(&selected_tool, &config_path)?;\n\n    // Generate launcher script\n    let launcher_name = format!(\"{}-launcher\", selected_tool.name);\n    let launcher_path = forge_dir.join(\"launchers\").join(&launcher_name);\n    if !non_interactive {\n        eprintln!(\"🚀 Generating launcher script...\");\n    }\n    generator::generate_launcher_script(&selected_tool, &launcher_path)?;\n\n    if !non_interactive {\n        eprintln!(\"\\n✅ Configuration complete!\");\n        eprintln!(\"   Config: {}\", config_path.display());\n        eprintln!(\"   Launcher: {}\", launcher_path.display());\n    }\n\n    info!(\n        \"Onboarding complete: using {} backend\",\n        selected_tool.name\n    );\n    Ok(())\n}\n\n/// Normalize backend name for comparison.\n///\n/// Maps common aliases to canonical names:\n/// - \"claude\", \"claude-code\", \"claudecode\" -> \"claude-code\"\n/// - \"opencode\" -> \"opencode\"\n/// - \"aider\" -> \"aider\"\nfn normalize_backend_name(name: &str) -> String {\n    let lower = name.to_lowercase();\n    match lower.as_str() {\n        \"claude\" | \"claude-code\" | \"claudecode\" => \"claude-code\".to_string(),\n        other => other.to_string(),\n    }\n}\n\n/// Handle the `forge init` command.\nfn handle_init_command(non_interactive: bool, force: bool, reconfigure: bool, detect_tools: bool) -> ExitCode {\n    info!(\n        \"Handling init command (non_interactive={}, force={}, reconfigure={}, detect_tools={})\",\n        non_interactive, force, reconfigure, detect_tools\n    );\n\n    // Handle --detect-tools: dry run that only shows detection results\n    if detect_tools {\n        return handle_detect_tools_command();\n    }\n\n    let forge_dir = get_forge_dir();\n    let config_path = forge_dir.join(\"config.yaml\");\n\n    // Handle --reconfigure: backup existing config before re-running setup\n    if reconfigure {\n        if !config_path.exists() {\n            if non_interactive {\n                eprintln!(\"error: No configuration found to reconfigure\");\n                eprintln!(\"Use 'forge init' to create initial configuration\");\n            } else {\n                eprintln!(\"No configuration found. Running first-time setup instead...\\n\");\n            }\n            // Fall through to normal setup since there's nothing to reconfigure\n        } else {\n            // Backup existing config before proceeding\n            if let Err(e) = backup_config(&forge_dir, &config_path) {\n                eprintln!(\"❌ Failed to backup config: {}\", e);\n                return ExitCode::from(1);\n            }\n            if !non_interactive {\n                eprintln!(\"📦 Existing configuration backed up\\n\");\n            }\n        }\n    } else if !force && config_path.exists() {\n        // Neither --force nor --reconfigure: don't overwrite existing config\n        if non_interactive {\n            eprintln!(\n                \"error: Configuration already exists at {}\",\n                config_path.display()\n            );\n            eprintln!(\"Use --force to overwrite existing configuration\");\n            eprintln!(\"Use --reconfigure to backup and re-run setup\");\n            return ExitCode::from(1);\n        } else {\n            eprintln!(\n                \"Configuration already exists at {}\",\n                config_path.display()\n            );\n            eprintln!(\"Use --force to overwrite existing configuration\");\n            eprintln!(\"Use --reconfigure to backup and re-run setup\");\n            return ExitCode::SUCCESS;\n        }\n    }\n\n    // Get preferred backend from environment variable\n    let preferred_backend = std::env::var(\"FORGE_CHAT_BACKEND\").ok();\n\n    if non_interactive {\n        // Non-interactive mode: quiet output, clear error messages to stderr\n        match run_onboarding(true, preferred_backend.as_deref()) {\n            Ok(()) => ExitCode::SUCCESS,\n            Err(_) => ExitCode::from(1),\n        }\n    } else {\n        // Interactive mode: show welcome message and full output\n        eprintln!(\"🚀 FORGE Setup\");\n        eprintln!();\n\n        match run_onboarding(false, preferred_backend.as_deref()) {\n            Ok(()) => {\n                eprintln!(\"\\n✅ Setup complete!\");\n                ExitCode::SUCCESS\n            }\n            Err(e) => {\n                eprintln!(\"❌ Setup failed: {}\", e);\n                ExitCode::from(1)\n            }\n        }\n    }\n}\n\n/// Backup existing config.yaml before reconfiguration.\n///\n/// Creates a timestamped backup to preserve user's previous settings.\n/// Keeps logs, costs database, and status files intact.\nfn backup_config(forge_dir: &std::path::Path, config_path: &std::path::Path) -> Result<std::path::PathBuf, Box<dyn std::error::Error>> {\n    let timestamp = chrono::Local::now().format(\"%Y%m%d_%H%M%S\");\n    let backup_path = forge_dir.join(format!(\"config.yaml.backup.{}\", timestamp));\n\n    std::fs::copy(config_path, &backup_path)?;\n    info!(\"Backed up config to: {}\", backup_path.display());\n\n    // Check for launcher scripts that might have custom modifications\n    let launchers_dir = forge_dir.join(\"launchers\");\n    if launchers_dir.exists()\n        && let Ok(entries) = std::fs::read_dir(&launchers_dir)\n    {\n        for entry in entries.flatten() {\n            let path = entry.path();\n            if path.is_file() {\n                // Check if the file contains any comments that suggest custom modifications\n                if let Ok(content) = std::fs::read_to_string(&path)\n                    && (content.contains(\"# CUSTOM:\") || content.contains(\"# USER:\") || content.contains(\"# Modified by\")) {\n                        eprintln!(\"⚠️  Warning: {} may contain custom modifications\", path.display());\n                        // Backup the launcher script too\n                        let launcher_backup = forge_dir.join(format!(\n                            \"launchers/{}.backup.{}\",\n                            entry.file_name().to_string_lossy(),\n                            timestamp\n                        ));\n                        let _ = std::fs::copy(&path, &launcher_backup);\n                    }\n            }\n        }\n    }\n\n    Ok(backup_path)\n}\n\n/// Handle the `forge init --detect-tools` command.\n///\n/// Runs CLI tool detection and displays results without modifying any files.\nfn handle_detect_tools_command() -> ExitCode {\n    info!(\"Running CLI tool detection (dry run)\");\n\n    eprintln!(\"🔍 Detecting available CLI tools...\\n\");\n\n    match detection::detect_cli_tools_with_diagnostics() {\n        Ok((tools, diagnostics)) => {\n            // Display all detected tools\n            if tools.is_empty() {\n                eprintln!(\"No CLI tools found.\\n\");\n            } else {\n                eprintln!(\"Detected CLI tools:\\n\");\n                for tool in &tools {\n                    let status_icon = match tool.status {\n                        detection::ToolStatus::Ready => \"✅\",\n                        detection::ToolStatus::MissingApiKey => \"⚠️ \",\n                        detection::ToolStatus::IncompatibleVersion => \"❌\",\n                        detection::ToolStatus::NotExecutable => \"❌\",\n                    };\n\n                    eprintln!(\"  {} {} ({})\", status_icon, tool.name, tool.status_message());\n                    eprintln!(\"      Path: {}\", tool.binary_path.display());\n                    if let Some(version) = &tool.version {\n                        eprintln!(\"      Version: {}\", version);\n                    }\n                    eprintln!(\"      Headless: {} | Skip-Perms: {}\",\n                        if tool.headless_support { \"yes\" } else { \"no\" },\n                        if tool.skip_permissions { \"yes\" } else { \"no\" }\n                    );\n                    if tool.api_key_required {\n                        let key_status = if tool.api_key_detected { \"✅ found\" } else { \"❌ missing\" };\n                        if let Some(env_var) = &tool.api_key_env_var {\n                            eprintln!(\"      API Key: {} ({})\", key_status, env_var);\n                        } else {\n                            eprintln!(\"      API Key: {}\", key_status);\n                        }\n                    }\n                    eprintln!();\n                }\n            }\n\n            // Display diagnostics about rejected/not-found tools\n            if !diagnostics.rejections.is_empty() {\n                eprintln!(\"Detection details:\");\n                for rejection in &diagnostics.rejections {\n                    match &rejection.reason {\n                        guidance::RejectionReason::NotFound => {\n                            eprintln!(\"  • {} - not found in PATH\", rejection.tool_name);\n                        }\n                        guidance::RejectionReason::MissingApiKey { env_var, .. } => {\n                            eprintln!(\"  • {} - missing API key ({})\", rejection.tool_name, env_var);\n                        }\n                        guidance::RejectionReason::IncompatibleVersion { version, missing_feature, .. } => {\n                            let ver = version.as_deref().unwrap_or(\"unknown\");\n                            eprintln!(\"  • {} {} - incompatible: {}\", rejection.tool_name, ver, missing_feature);\n                        }\n                        guidance::RejectionReason::NotExecutable(_) => {\n                            eprintln!(\"  • {} - not executable\", rejection.tool_name);\n                        }\n                    }\n                }\n                eprintln!();\n            }\n\n            // Summary\n            let ready_count = tools.iter().filter(|t| t.is_ready()).count();\n            if ready_count > 0 {\n                eprintln!(\"✅ {} tool(s) ready for use\", ready_count);\n                eprintln!(\"   Run 'forge init' to configure\");\n            } else {\n                eprintln!(\"❌ No compatible tools ready\");\n                eprintln!(\"   Install Claude Code, OpenCode, or configure API keys\");\n            }\n\n            ExitCode::SUCCESS\n        }\n        Err(e) => {\n            eprintln!(\"❌ Detection failed: {}\", e);\n            ExitCode::from(1)\n        }\n    }\n}\n\n/// Validate the config file and offer recovery if invalid.\nfn validate_config() -> Result<(), String> {\n    use std::io::{self, Write};\n\n    match ForgeConfig::load_with_error() {\n        Ok(_config) => {\n            info!(\"Configuration validated successfully\");\n            Ok(())\n        }\n        Err(e) => {\n            // Format the error with line/column information\n            eprintln!(\"❌ Configuration Error\");\n            eprintln!();\n\n            let path_str = e.path().map(|p| p.display().to_string())\n                .unwrap_or_else(|| \"~/.forge/config.yaml\".to_string());\n\n            if let (Some(line), Some(col)) = (e.line_number(), e.column_number()) {\n                eprintln!(\"  File: {}\", path_str);\n                eprintln!(\"  Line: {}, Column: {}\", line, col);\n                eprintln!(\"  Error: {}\", e);\n            } else {\n                eprintln!(\"  {}\", e);\n            }\n            eprintln!();\n\n            // Offer recovery options\n            eprintln!(\"Recovery options:\");\n            eprintln!(\"  1) Reset to default configuration (creates backup)\");\n            eprintln!(\"  2) Use defaults without modifying file (temporary)\");\n            eprintln!(\"  3) Exit and fix manually\");\n            eprintln!();\n            eprint!(\"Choose option [1-3]: \");\n            io::stdout().flush().map_err(|e| e.to_string())?;\n\n            let mut choice = String::new();\n            io::stdin().read_line(&mut choice).map_err(|e| e.to_string())?;\n\n            match choice.trim() {\n                \"1\" => {\n                    if let Err(e) = reset_config_to_defaults() {\n                        return Err(format!(\"Failed to reset config: {}\", e));\n                    }\n                    eprintln!(\"✅ Configuration reset to defaults\");\n                    eprintln!(\"   Previous config backed up\");\n                    eprintln!();\n                    Ok(())\n                }\n                \"2\" => {\n                    eprintln!(\"⚠️  Using default configuration (file not modified)\");\n                    eprintln!(\"   Fix the config file manually or delete it to regenerate\");\n                    eprintln!();\n                    Ok(())\n                }\n                \"3\" | \"\" => {\n                    Err(\"Exiting. Please fix the config file and try again.\".to_string())\n                }\n                _ => {\n                    Err(\"Invalid choice. Exiting.\".to_string())\n                }\n            }\n        }\n    }\n}\n\n/// Reset config file to defaults with backup.\nfn reset_config_to_defaults() -> Result<(), Box<dyn std::error::Error>> {\n    let forge_dir = get_forge_dir();\n    let config_path = forge_dir.join(\"config.yaml\");\n\n    // Create backup\n    if config_path.exists() {\n        let timestamp = chrono::Local::now().format(\"%Y%m%d_%H%M%S\");\n        let backup_path = forge_dir.join(format!(\"config.yaml.backup.{}\", timestamp));\n        std::fs::copy(&config_path, &backup_path)?;\n        info!(\"Created config backup: {}\", backup_path.display());\n    }\n\n    // Generate default config\n    let default_config = r#\"# FORGE Configuration\n# This file was automatically generated after a config error.\n\ndashboard:\n  refresh_interval_ms: 1000\n  max_fps: 60\n  default_layout: overview\n\ntheme:\n  name: default\n\ncost_tracking:\n  enabled: true\n  budget_warning_threshold: 70\n  budget_critical_threshold: 90\n  # monthly_budget_usd: 100.0\n\n# Chat backend configuration (optional)\n# Uncomment and configure if using the chat feature:\n# chat_backend:\n#   command: claude-code\n#   args:\n#     - --headless\n#     - --model\n#     - sonnet\n#   model: sonnet\n\"#;\n\n    std::fs::write(&config_path, default_config)?;\n    info!(\"Reset config to defaults: {}\", config_path.display());\n    Ok(())\n}\n\n/// Handle worker subcommand actions.\nfn handle_worker_action(action: &WorkerAction) -> ExitCode {\n    let writer = match StatusWriter::new(None) {\n        Ok(w) => w,\n        Err(e) => {\n            eprintln!(\"❌ Failed to initialize status writer: {}\", e);\n            return ExitCode::from(1);\n        }\n    };\n\n    match action {\n        WorkerAction::Pause { id } => {\n            if id.to_lowercase() == \"all\" {\n                match writer.pause_all() {\n                    Ok(count) => {\n                        if count == 0 {\n                            eprintln!(\"No workers to pause\");\n                        } else {\n                            eprintln!(\"⏸️  Paused {} worker(s)\", count);\n                        }\n                        ExitCode::SUCCESS\n                    }\n                    Err(e) => {\n                        eprintln!(\"❌ Failed to pause workers: {}\", e);\n                        ExitCode::from(1)\n                    }\n                }\n            } else {\n                match writer.pause_worker(id) {\n                    Ok(()) => {\n                        eprintln!(\"⏸️  Paused worker: {}\", id);\n                        ExitCode::SUCCESS\n                    }\n                    Err(e) => {\n                        eprintln!(\"❌ Failed to pause worker '{}': {}\", id, e);\n                        ExitCode::from(1)\n                    }\n                }\n            }\n        }\n        WorkerAction::Resume { id } => {\n            if id.to_lowercase() == \"all\" {\n                match writer.resume_all() {\n                    Ok(count) => {\n                        if count == 0 {\n                            eprintln!(\"No workers to resume\");\n                        } else {\n                            eprintln!(\"▶️  Resumed {} worker(s)\", count);\n                        }\n                        ExitCode::SUCCESS\n                    }\n                    Err(e) => {\n                        eprintln!(\"❌ Failed to resume workers: {}\", e);\n                        ExitCode::from(1)\n                    }\n                }\n            } else {\n                match writer.resume_worker(id) {\n                    Ok(()) => {\n                        eprintln!(\"▶️  Resumed worker: {}\", id);\n                        ExitCode::SUCCESS\n                    }\n                    Err(e) => {\n                        eprintln!(\"❌ Failed to resume worker '{}': {}\", id, e);\n                        ExitCode::from(1)\n                    }\n                }\n            }\n        }\n    }\n}\n\n/// Handle the `forge validate` command.\nfn handle_validate_command(verbose: bool, fix: bool, skip_backend_test: bool, json: bool) -> ExitCode {\n    info!(\n        \"Handling validate command (verbose={}, fix={}, skip_backend_test={}, json={})\",\n        verbose, fix, skip_backend_test, json\n    );\n\n    let forge_dir = get_forge_dir();\n\n    // Run comprehensive validation\n    let results = validator::validate_comprehensive(&forge_dir, verbose, fix, skip_backend_test);\n\n    // Output results\n    if json {\n        // JSON output\n        match serde_json::to_string_pretty(&results) {\n            Ok(json_output) => {\n                println!(\"{}\", json_output);\n            }\n            Err(e) => {\n                eprintln!(\"❌ Failed to serialize results to JSON: {}\", e);\n                return ExitCode::from(1);\n            }\n        }\n    } else {\n        // Human-readable output\n        print_validation_results(&results, verbose);\n    }\n\n    // Return appropriate exit code\n    if results.passed {\n        ExitCode::SUCCESS\n    } else {\n        ExitCode::from(1)\n    }\n}\n\n/// Print validation results in human-readable format.\nfn print_validation_results(results: &validator::ComprehensiveValidationResults, verbose: bool) {\n    // Config file\n    if results.config_valid {\n        println!(\"✅ Config file: valid\");\n    } else {\n        println!(\"❌ Config file: invalid\");\n    }\n\n    // Launchers\n    if results.launcher_valid {\n        let count = results.launcher_count;\n        println!(\"✅ Launchers: {} found, executable\", count);\n        if verbose {\n            for launcher in &results.launcher_names {\n                println!(\"   - {}\", launcher);\n            }\n        }\n    } else {\n        println!(\"❌ Launchers: {}\", results.launcher_message);\n    }\n\n    // Directories\n    if results.directories_valid {\n        println!(\"✅ Directories: all present\");\n    } else {\n        println!(\"❌ Directories: missing\");\n        for dir in &results.missing_directories {\n            println!(\"   - {}\", dir);\n        }\n    }\n\n    // Chat backend (only shown if tested)\n    match &results.backend_status {\n        validator::BackendStatus::NotTested => {\n            println!(\"⚠️  Chat backend: not tested (use --test-backend)\");\n        }\n        validator::BackendStatus::Skipped => {\n            println!(\"⏭️  Chat backend: skipped (--skip-backend-test)\");\n        }\n        validator::BackendStatus::Ready { command } => {\n            println!(\"✅ Chat backend: ready ({})\", command);\n        }\n        validator::BackendStatus::NotConfigured => {\n            println!(\"⚠️  Chat backend: not configured\");\n        }\n        validator::BackendStatus::CommandNotFound { command } => {\n            println!(\"❌ Chat backend: command not found ({})\", command);\n        }\n        validator::BackendStatus::Error { message } => {\n            println!(\"❌ Chat backend: error - {}\", message);\n        }\n    }\n\n    // Warnings\n    if !results.warnings.is_empty() {\n        println!();\n        println!(\"Warnings:\");\n        for warning in &results.warnings {\n            println!(\"  ⚠️  {}\", warning);\n        }\n    }\n\n    // Fixes applied\n    if !results.fixes_applied.is_empty() eprintln!(\"Terminal size: {}x{} (columns x rows)\", cols, rows);\n    } else {\n        error!(\"Failed to get terminal size\");\n    }\n\n    // Run the TUI application\n    match run_app() {\n        Ok(()) => {\n            info!(\"FORGE dashboard exited normally\");\n            ExitCode::SUCCESS\n        }\n        Err(e) => {\n            error!(\"FORGE dashboard error: {}\", e);\n            eprintln!(\"Error: {}\", e);\n            ExitCode::from(1)\n        }\n    }\n}\n\n/// Install a panic hook that restores the terminal before printing the panic message.\n///\n/// This ensures that even if the application panics while in raw mode with the\n/// alternate screen enabled, the terminal will be properly restored so the user\n/// can see the panic message and continue using their terminal.\nfn install_panic_hook() {\n    let original_hook = panic::take_hook();\n\n    panic::set_hook(Box::new(move |panic_info| {\n        // Attempt to restore terminal state\n        let _ = restore_terminal();\n\n        // Call the original panic hook to print the panic message\n        original_hook(panic_info);\n    }));\n}\n\n/// Restore terminal to its normal state.\n///\n/// This function is called both on normal exit and during panic handling.\nfn restore_terminal() -> std::io::Result<()> {\n    let mut stdout = std::io::stdout();\n\n    // Disable raw mode first\n    let _ = crossterm::terminal::disable_raw_mode();\n\n    // Leave alternate screen and disable mouse capture\n    crossterm::execute!(\n        stdout,\n        crossterm::terminal::LeaveAlternateScreen,\n        crossterm::event::DisableMouseCapture\n    )?;\n\n    // Show cursor\n    crossterm::execute!(stdout, crossterm::cursor::Show)?;\n\n    // Flush to ensure all escape sequences are written\n    stdout.flush()?;\n\n    Ok(())\n}\n\n/// Set up logging based on CLI arguments.\nfn setup_logging(cli: &Cli) -> forge_core::Result<LogGuard> {\n    // Initialize logging with the specified log directory\n    // Either --debug or -v/--verbose enables debug logging\n    let debug = cli.debug || cli.verbose > 0;\n    init_logging(cli.log_dir.clone(), debug)\n}\n\n/// Check if onboarding is needed (no config.yaml exists).\nfn needs_onboarding() -> bool {\n    let forge_dir = get_forge_dir();\n    let config_path = forge_dir.join(\"config.yaml\");\n    !config_path.exists()\n}\n\n/// Get the FORGE directory path (~/.forge).\nfn get_forge_dir() -> std::path::PathBuf {\n    dirs::home_dir()\n        .expect(\"Could not determine home directory\")\n        .join(\".forge\")\n}\n\n/// Run the onboarding flow.\n///\n/// # Arguments\n///\n/// * `non_interactive` - If true, suppress output and auto-select backend\n/// * `preferred_backend` - Optional backend to use (from FORGE_CHAT_BACKEND env var)\nfn run_onboarding(\n    non_interactive: bool,\n    preferred_backend: Option<&str>,\n) -> Result<(), Box<dyn std::error::Error>> {\n    info!(\n        \"Starting onboarding flow (non_interactive={}, preferred_backend={:?})\",\n        non_interactive, preferred_backend\n    );\n\n    // Detect CLI tools with diagnostics\n    if !non_interactive {\n        eprintln!(\"🔍 Detecting available CLI tools...\");\n    }\n    let (tools, diagnostics) = detection::detect_cli_tools_with_diagnostics()?;\n\n    // Filter to only show tools that are ready to use\n    let ready_tools: Vec<_> = tools.iter().filter(|t| t.is_ready()).collect();\n\n    if ready_tools.is_empty() {\n        // Use the guidance module to show detailed instructions (both interactive and non-interactive)\n        eprint!(\"{}\", guidance::generate_guidance(Some(&diagnostics)));\n        return Err(\"No compatible CLI tools available\".into());\n    }\n\n    // Select the backend to use\n    let selected_tool: detection::CliToolDetection = if let Some(backend) = preferred_backend {\n        // Try to find the specified backend\n        let normalized_backend = normalize_backend_name(backend);\n        let found = tools.iter().find(|t| {\n            let tool_name = normalize_backend_name(&t.name);\n            tool_name == normalized_backend\n        });\n\n        match found {\n            Some(tool) => {\n                if !tool.is_ready() {\n                    eprintln!(\n                        \"error: Backend '{}' is not ready: {}\",\n                        backend,\n                        tool.status_message()\n                    );\n                    if tool.status == detection::ToolStatus::MissingApiKey\n                        && let Some(env_var) = &tool.api_key_env_var\n                    {\n                        eprintln!(\"Set the {} environment variable and try again\", env_var);\n                    }\n                    return Err(format!(\"Backend '{}' is not ready\", backend).into());\n                }\n                tool.clone()\n            }\n            None => {\n                eprintln!(\"error: Backend '{}' not found\", backend);\n                eprintln!(\n                    \"Available backends: {}\",\n                    tools\n                        .iter()\n                        .map(|t| t.name.as_str())\n                        .collect::<Vec<_>>()\n                        .join(\", \")\n                );\n                return Err(format!(\"Backend '{}' not found\", backend).into());\n            }\n        }\n    } else if non_interactive {\n        // Auto-select the first ready tool in non-interactive mode\n        match tools.iter().find(|t| t.is_ready()) {\n            Some(tool) => tool.clone(),\n            None => {\n                // Tools exist but none are ready - show specific guidance\n                let not_ready: Vec<_> = tools\n                    .iter()\n                    .filter(|t| !t.is_ready())\n                    .map(|t| {\n                        let (missing_api_key, incompatible_version, missing_feature) = match t.status {\n                            detection::ToolStatus::MissingApiKey => (true, false, None),\n                            detection::ToolStatus::IncompatibleVersion => {\n                                // Extract missing feature from diagnostics\n                                let feature = diagnostics\n                                    .rejections\n                                    .iter()\n                                    .find(|r| r.tool_name == t.name || r.tool_name == t.name.replace(\"-code\", \"\"))\n                                    .and_then(|r| match &r.reason {\n                                        guidance::RejectionReason::IncompatibleVersion { missing_feature, .. } => {\n                                            Some(missing_feature.clone())\n                                        }\n                                        _ => None,\n                                    });\n                                (false, true, feature)\n                            }\n                            _ => (false, false, None),\n                        };\n                        guidance::ToolFixInfo {\n                            name: t.name.clone(),\n                            version: t.version.clone(),\n                            missing_api_key,\n                            api_key_env_var: t.api_key_env_var.clone(),\n                            incompatible_version,\n                            missing_feature,\n                        }\n                    })\n                    .collect();\n\n                if !not_ready.is_empty() {\n                    eprint!(\"{}\", guidance::generate_not_ready_guidance(&not_ready));\n                }\n                return Err(\"No ready tools available\".into());\n            }\n        }\n    } else {\n        // Interactive mode: show the TUI wizard for selection\n        match wizard::run_wizard(tools.clone()) {\n            Ok(Some(tool)) => {\n                // User selected a tool\n                eprintln!(\n                    \"\\n✨ Using: {} ({})\",\n                    tool.name,\n                    tool.binary_path.display()\n                );\n                tool\n            }\n            Ok(None) => {\n                // User chose \"Manual Setup\" - skip auto-configuration\n                eprintln!(\"\\n📝 Manual setup selected.\");\n                eprintln!(\"   Create ~/.forge/config.yaml manually to configure FORGE.\");\n                return Ok(());\n            }\n            Err(wizard::WizardError::UserCancelled) => {\n                eprintln!(\"\\n👋 Setup cancelled.\");\n                return Err(\"User cancelled setup\".into());\n            }\n            Err(wizard::WizardError::NoToolsAvailable) => {\n                // This shouldn't happen since we already checked, but handle it\n                eprint!(\"{}\", guidance::generate_guidance(Some(&diagnostics)));\n                return Err(\"No compatible CLI tools available\".into());\n            }\n            Err(e) => {\n                eprintln!(\"\\nerror: Wizard failed: {}\", e);\n                return Err(format!(\"Wizard failed: {}\", e).into());\n            }\n        }\n    };\n\n    if non_interactive {\n        // Only print in non-interactive mode (wizard already prints in interactive mode)\n        info!(\n            \"Auto-selected: {} ({})\",\n            selected_tool.name,\n            selected_tool.binary_path.display()\n        );\n    }\n\n    // Create directory structure\n    let forge_dir = get_forge_dir();\n    if !non_interactive {\n        eprintln!(\"\\n📁 Creating directory structure...\");\n    }\n    generator::create_directory_structure(&forge_dir)?;\n\n    // Generate config.yaml\n    let config_path = forge_dir.join(\"config.yaml\");\n    if !non_interactive {\n        eprintln!(\"📝 Generating config.yaml...\");\n    }\n    generator::generate_config_yaml(&selected_tool, &config_path)?;\n\n    // Generate launcher script\n    let launcher_name = format!(\"{}-launcher\", selected_tool.name);\n    let launcher_path = forge_dir.join(\"launchers\").join(&launcher_name);\n    if !non_interactive {\n        eprintln!(\"🚀 Generating launcher script...\");\n    }\n    generator::generate_launcher_script(&selected_tool, &launcher_path)?;\n\n    if !non_interactive {\n        eprintln!(\"\\n✅ Configuration complete!\");\n        eprintln!(\"   Config: {}\", config_path.display());\n        eprintln!(\"   Launcher: {}\", launcher_path.display());\n    }\n\n    info!(\n        \"Onboarding complete: using {} backend\",\n        selected_tool.name\n    );\n    Ok(())\n}\n\n/// Normalize backend name for comparison.\n///\n/// Maps common aliases to canonical names:\n/// - \"claude\", \"claude-code\", \"claudecode\" -> \"claude-code\"\n/// - \"opencode\" -> \"opencode\"\n/// - \"aider\" -> \"aider\"\nfn normalize_backend_name(name: &str) -> String {\n    let lower = name.to_lowercase();\n    match lower.as_str() {\n        \"claude\" | \"claude-code\" | \"claudecode\" => \"claude-code\".to_string(),\n        other => other.to_string(),\n    }\n}\n\n/// Handle the `forge init` command.\nfn handle_init_command(non_interactive: bool, force: bool, reconfigure: bool, detect_tools: bool) -> ExitCode {\n    info!(\n        \"Handling init command (non_interactive={}, force={}, reconfigure={}, detect_tools={})\",\n        non_interactive, force, reconfigure, detect_tools\n    );\n\n    // Handle --detect-tools: dry run that only shows detection results\n    if detect_tools {\n        return handle_detect_tools_command();\n    }\n\n    let forge_dir = get_forge_dir();\n    let config_path = forge_dir.join(\"config.yaml\");\n\n    // Handle --reconfigure: backup existing config before re-running setup\n    if reconfigure {\n        if !config_path.exists() {\n            if non_interactive {\n                eprintln!(\"error: No configuration found to reconfigure\");\n                eprintln!(\"Use 'forge init' to create initial configuration\");\n            } else {\n                eprintln!(\"No configuration found. Running first-time setup instead...\\n\");\n            }\n            // Fall through to normal setup since there's nothing to reconfigure\n        } else {\n            // Backup existing config before proceeding\n            if let Err(e) = backup_config(&forge_dir, &config_path) {\n                eprintln!(\"❌ Failed to backup config: {}\", e);\n                return ExitCode::from(1);\n            }\n            if !non_interactive {\n                eprintln!(\"📦 Existing configuration backed up\\n\");\n            }\n        }\n    } else if !force && config_path.exists() {\n        // Neither --force nor --reconfigure: don't overwrite existing config\n        if non_interactive {\n            eprintln!(\n                \"error: Configuration already exists at {}\",\n                config_path.display()\n            );\n            eprintln!(\"Use --force to overwrite existing configuration\");\n            eprintln!(\"Use --reconfigure to backup and re-run setup\");\n            return ExitCode::from(1);\n        } else {\n            eprintln!(\n                \"Configuration already exists at {}\",\n                config_path.display()\n            );\n            eprintln!(\"Use --force to overwrite existing configuration\");\n            eprintln!(\"Use --reconfigure to backup and re-run setup\");\n            return ExitCode::SUCCESS;\n        }\n    }\n\n    // Get preferred backend from environment variable\n    let preferred_backend = std::env::var(\"FORGE_CHAT_BACKEND\").ok();\n\n    if non_interactive {\n        // Non-interactive mode: quiet output, clear error messages to stderr\n        match run_onboarding(true, preferred_backend.as_deref()) {\n            Ok(()) => ExitCode::SUCCESS,\n            Err(_) => ExitCode::from(1),\n        }\n    } else {\n        // Interactive mode: show welcome message and full output\n        eprintln!(\"🚀 FORGE Setup\");\n        eprintln!();\n\n        match run_onboarding(false, preferred_backend.as_deref()) {\n            Ok(()) => {\n                eprintln!(\"\\n✅ Setup complete!\");\n                ExitCode::SUCCESS\n            }\n            Err(e) => {\n                eprintln!(\"❌ Setup failed: {}\", e);\n                ExitCode::from(1)\n            }\n        }\n    }\n}\n\n/// Backup existing config.yaml before reconfiguration.\n///\n/// Creates a timestamped backup to preserve user's previous settings.\n/// Keeps logs, costs database, and status files intact.\nfn backup_config(forge_dir: &std::path::Path, config_path: &std::path::Path) -> Result<std::path::PathBuf, Box<dyn std::error::Error>> {\n    let timestamp = chrono::Local::now().format(\"%Y%m%d_%H%M%S\");\n    let backup_path = forge_dir.join(format!(\"config.yaml.backup.{}\", timestamp));\n\n    std::fs::copy(config_path, &backup_path)?;\n    info!(\"Backed up config to: {}\", backup_path.display());\n\n    // Check for launcher scripts that might have custom modifications\n    let launchers_dir = forge_dir.join(\"launchers\");\n    if launchers_dir.exists()\n        && let Ok(entries) = std::fs::read_dir(&launchers_dir)\n    {\n        for entry in entries.flatten() {\n            let path = entry.path();\n            if path.is_file() {\n                // Check if the file contains any comments that suggest custom modifications\n                if let Ok(content) = std::fs::read_to_string(&path)\n                    && (content.contains(\"# CUSTOM:\") || content.contains(\"# USER:\") || content.contains(\"# Modified by\")) {\n                        eprintln!(\"⚠️  Warning: {} may contain custom modifications\", path.display());\n                        // Backup the launcher script too\n                        let launcher_backup = forge_dir.join(format!(\n                            \"launchers/{}.backup.{}\",\n                            entry.file_name().to_string_lossy(),\n                            timestamp\n                        ));\n                        let _ = std::fs::copy(&path, &launcher_backup);\n                    }\n            }\n        }\n    }\n\n    Ok(backup_path)\n}\n\n/// Handle the `forge init --detect-tools` command.\n///\n/// Runs CLI tool detection and displays results without modifying any files.\nfn handle_detect_tools_command() -> ExitCode {\n    info!(\"Running CLI tool detection (dry run)\");\n\n    eprintln!(\"🔍 Detecting available CLI tools...\\n\");\n\n    match detection::detect_cli_tools_with_diagnostics() {\n        Ok((tools, diagnostics)) => {\n            // Display all detected tools\n            if tools.is_empty() {\n                eprintln!(\"No CLI tools found.\\n\");\n            } else {\n                eprintln!(\"Detected CLI tools:\\n\");\n                for tool in &tools {\n                    let status_icon = match tool.status {\n                        detection::ToolStatus::Ready => \"✅\",\n                        detection::ToolStatus::MissingApiKey => \"⚠️ \",\n                        detection::ToolStatus::IncompatibleVersion => \"❌\",\n                        detection::ToolStatus::NotExecutable => \"❌\",\n                    };\n\n                    eprintln!(\"  {} {} ({})\", status_icon, tool.name, tool.status_message());\n                    eprintln!(\"      Path: {}\", tool.binary_path.display());\n                    if let Some(version) = &tool.version {\n                        eprintln!(\"      Version: {}\", version);\n                    }\n                    eprintln!(\"      Headless: {} | Skip-Perms: {}\",\n                        if tool.headless_support { \"yes\" } else { \"no\" },\n                        if tool.skip_permissions { \"yes\" } else { \"no\" }\n                    );\n                    if tool.api_key_required {\n                        let key_status = if tool.api_key_detected { \"✅ found\" } else { \"❌ missing\" };\n                        if let Some(env_var) = &tool.api_key_env_var {\n                            eprintln!(\"      API Key: {} ({})\", key_status, env_var);\n                        } else {\n                            eprintln!(\"      API Key: {}\", key_status);\n                        }\n                    }\n                    eprintln!();\n                }\n            }\n\n            // Display diagnostics about rejected/not-found tools\n            if !diagnostics.rejections.is_empty() {\n                eprintln!(\"Detection details:\");\n                for rejection in &diagnostics.rejections {\n                    match &rejection.reason {\n                        guidance::RejectionReason::NotFound => {\n                            eprintln!(\"  • {} - not found in PATH\", rejection.tool_name);\n                        }\n                        guidance::RejectionReason::MissingApiKey { env_var, .. } => {\n                            eprintln!(\"  • {} - missing API key ({})\", rejection.tool_name, env_var);\n                        }\n                        guidance::RejectionReason::IncompatibleVersion { version, missing_feature, .. } => {\n                            let ver = version.as_deref().unwrap_or(\"unknown\");\n                            eprintln!(\"  • {} {} - incompatible: {}\", rejection.tool_name, ver, missing_feature);\n                        }\n                        guidance::RejectionReason::NotExecutable(_) => {\n                            eprintln!(\"  • {} - not executable\", rejection.tool_name);\n                        }\n                    }\n                }\n                eprintln!();\n            }\n\n            // Summary\n            let ready_count = tools.iter().filter(|t| t.is_ready()).count();\n            if ready_count > 0 {\n                eprintln!(\"✅ {} tool(s) ready for use\", ready_count);\n                eprintln!(\"   Run 'forge init' to configure\");\n            } else {\n                eprintln!(\"❌ No compatible tools ready\");\n                eprintln!(\"   Install Claude Code, OpenCode, or configure API keys\");\n            }\n\n            ExitCode::SUCCESS\n        }\n        Err(e) => {\n            eprintln!(\"❌ Detection failed: {}\", e);\n            ExitCode::from(1)\n        }\n    }\n}\n\n/// Validate the config file and offer recovery if invalid.\nfn validate_config() -> Result<(), String> {\n    use std::io::{self, Write};\n\n    match ForgeConfig::load_with_error() {\n        Ok(_config) => {\n            info!(\"Configuration validated successfully\");\n            Ok(())\n        }\n        Err(e) => {\n            // Format the error with line/column information\n            eprintln!(\"❌ Configuration Error\");\n            eprintln!();\n\n            let path_str = e.path().map(|p| p.display().to_string())\n                .unwrap_or_else(|| \"~/.forge/config.yaml\".to_string());\n\n            if let (Some(line), Some(col)) = (e.line_number(), e.column_number()) {\n                eprintln!(\"  File: {}\", path_str);\n                eprintln!(\"  Line: {}, Column: {}\", line, col);\n                eprintln!(\"  Error: {}\", e);\n            } else {\n                eprintln!(\"  {}\", e);\n            }\n            eprintln!();\n\n            // Offer recovery options\n            eprintln!(\"Recovery options:\");\n            eprintln!(\"  1) Reset to default configuration (creates backup)\");\n            eprintln!(\"  2) Use defaults without modifying file (temporary)\");\n            eprintln!(\"  3) Exit and fix manually\");\n            eprintln!();\n            eprint!(\"Choose option [1-3]: \");\n            io::stdout().flush().map_err(|e| e.to_string())?;\n\n            let mut choice = String::new();\n            io::stdin().read_line(&mut choice).map_err(|e| e.to_string())?;\n\n            match choice.trim() {\n                \"1\" => {\n                    if let Err(e) = reset_config_to_defaults() {\n                        return Err(format!(\"Failed to reset config: {}\", e));\n                    }\n                    eprintln!(\"✅ Configuration reset to defaults\");\n                    eprintln!(\"   Previous config backed up\");\n                    eprintln!();\n                    Ok(())\n                }\n                \"2\" => {\n                    eprintln!(\"⚠️  Using default configuration (file not modified)\");\n                    eprintln!(\"   Fix the config file manually or delete it to regenerate\");\n                    eprintln!();\n                    Ok(())\n                }\n                \"3\" | \"\" => {\n                    Err(\"Exiting. Please fix the config file and try again.\".to_string())\n                }\n                _ => {\n                    Err(\"Invalid choice. Exiting.\".to_string())\n                }\n            }\n        }\n    }\n}\n\n/// Reset config file to defaults with backup.\nfn reset_config_to_defaults() -> Result<(), Box<dyn std::error::Error>> {\n    let forge_dir = get_forge_dir();\n    let config_path = forge_dir.join(\"config.yaml\");\n\n    // Create backup\n    if config_path.exists() {\n        let timestamp = chrono::Local::now().format(\"%Y%m%d_%H%M%S\");\n        let backup_path = forge_dir.join(format!(\"config.yaml.backup.{}\", timestamp));\n        std::fs::copy(&config_path, &backup_path)?;\n        info!(\"Created config backup: {}\", backup_path.display());\n    }\n\n    // Generate default config\n    let default_config = r#\"# FORGE Configuration\n# This file was automatically generated after a config error.\n\ndashboard:\n  refresh_interval_ms: 1000\n  max_fps: 60\n  default_layout: overview\n\ntheme:\n  name: default\n\ncost_tracking:\n  enabled: true\n  budget_warning_threshold: 70\n  budget_critical_threshold: 90\n  # monthly_budget_usd: 100.0\n\n# Chat backend configuration (optional)\n# Uncomment and configure if using the chat feature:\n# chat_backend:\n#   command: claude-code\n#   args:\n#     - --headless\n#     - --model\n#     - sonnet\n#   model: sonnet\n\"#;\n\n    std::fs::write(&config_path, default_config)?;\n    info!(\"Reset config to defaults: {}\", config_path.display());\n    Ok(())\n}\n\n/// Handle worker subcommand actions.\nfn handle_worker_action(action: &WorkerAction) -> ExitCode {\n    let writer = match StatusWriter::new(None) {\n        Ok(w) => w,\n        Err(e) => {\n            eprintln!(\"❌ Failed to initialize status writer: {}\", e);\n            return ExitCode::from(1);\n        }\n    };\n\n    match action {\n        WorkerAction::Pause { id } => {\n            if id.to_lowercase() == \"all\" {\n                match writer.pause_all() {\n                    Ok(count) => {\n                        if count == 0 {\n                            eprintln!(\"No workers to pause\");\n                        } else {\n                            eprintln!(\"⏸️  Paused {} worker(s)\", count);\n                        }\n                        ExitCode::SUCCESS\n                    }\n                    Err(e) => {\n                        eprintln!(\"❌ Failed to pause workers: {}\", e);\n                        ExitCode::from(1)\n                    }\n                }\n            } else {\n                match writer.pause_worker(id) {\n                    Ok(()) => {\n                        eprintln!(\"⏸️  Paused worker: {}\", id);\n                        ExitCode::SUCCESS\n                    }\n                    Err(e) => {\n                        eprintln!(\"❌ Failed to pause worker '{}': {}\", id, e);\n                        ExitCode::from(1)\n                    }\n                }\n            }\n        }\n        WorkerAction::Resume { id } => {\n            if id.to_lowercase() == \"all\" {\n                match writer.resume_all() {\n                    Ok(count) => {\n                        if count == 0 {\n                            eprintln!(\"No workers to resume\");\n                        } else {\n                            eprintln!(\"▶️  Resumed {} worker(s)\", count);\n                        }\n                        ExitCode::SUCCESS\n                    }\n                    Err(e) => {\n                        eprintln!(\"❌ Failed to resume workers: {}\", e);\n                        ExitCode::from(1)\n                    }\n                }\n            } else {\n                match writer.resume_worker(id) {\n                    Ok(()) => {\n                        eprintln!(\"▶️  Resumed worker: {}\", id);\n                        ExitCode::SUCCESS\n                    }\n                    Err(e) => {\n                        eprintln!(\"❌ Failed to resume worker '{}': {}\", id, e);\n                        ExitCode::from(1)\n                    }\n                }\n            }\n        }\n    }\n}\n\n/// Handle the `forge validate` command.\nfn handle_validate_command(verbose: bool, fix: bool, skip_backend_test: bool, json: bool) -> ExitCode {\n    info!(\n        \"Handling validate command (verbose={}, fix={}, skip_backend_test={}, json={})\",\n        verbose, fix, skip_backend_test, json\n    );\n\n    let forge_dir = get_forge_dir();\n\n    // Run comprehensive validation\n    let results = validator::validate_comprehensive(&forge_dir, verbose, fix, skip_backend_test);\n\n    // Output results\n    if json {\n        // JSON output\n        match serde_json::to_string_pretty(&results) {\n            Ok(json_output) => {\n                println!(\"{}\", json_output);\n            }\n            Err(e) => {\n                eprintln!(\"❌ Failed to serialize results to JSON: {}\", e);\n                return ExitCode::from(1);\n            }\n        }\n    } else {\n        // Human-readable output\n        print_validation_results(&results, verbose);\n    }\n\n    // Return appropriate exit code\n    if results.passed {\n        ExitCode::SUCCESS\n    } else {\n        ExitCode::from(1)\n    }\n}\n\n/// Print validation results in human-readable format.\nfn print_validation_results(results: certificates (default: true for production)\n    #[arg(long, default_value = \"true\")]\n    server_tls_verify: bool,\n\n    /// Minimum TLS version (default: TLSv1.2)\n    #[arg(long, default_value = \"TLSv1.2\")]\n    server_tls_min_version: String,\n\n    /// Path to server configuration file (YAML format)\n    #[arg(long)]\n    server_config: Option<std::path::PathBuf>,\n\n    /// Enable client user: Option<String>,\n\n    /// Password for server authentication\n    #[arg(long, value_name = \"PASSWORD\")]\n    password: Option<String>,\n\n    /// Subcommands\n    #[command(subcommand)]\n    command: Option<Commands>,\n}\n\n#[derive(Subcommand, Debug)]\nenum Commands {\n    /// Initialize FORGE configuration (first-time setup)\n    Init {\n        /// Run in non-interactive mode (for CI/automation)\n        /// Auto-selects first available backend or uses FORGE_CHAT_BACKEND env var\n        #[arg(long)]\n        non_interactive: bool,\n\n        /// Force re-initialization even if config exists\n        #[arg(long)]\n        force: bool,\n\n        /// Re-run setup on existing config (backs up config first)\n        /// Use this to change settings while preserving user data (logs, costs, status)\n        #[arg(long, conflicts_with = \"force\")]\n        reconfigure: bool,\n\n        /// Only detect available CLI tools and show results (dry run)\n        /// Does not modify any files\n        #[arg(long, conflicts_with_all = [\"force\", \"reconfigure\"])]\n        detect_tools: bool,\n    },\n\n    /// Update forge binary from a URL\n    Update {\n        /// URL \"forge\")\n        #[arg(short, long, default_value = \"forge\")]\n        filename: String,\n    },\n\n    /// Rollback to the previous version\n    Rollback,\n\n    /// Clean the staging directory\n    CleanStaging,\n\n    /// Manage workers\n    Worker {\n        #[command(subcommand)]\n        action: WorkerAction,\n    },\n\n    /// Validate FORGE configuration\n    Validate {\n        /// Show detailed validation results\n        #[arg(long, short = 'v')]\n        verbose: bool,\n\n        /// Attempt automatic fixes for issues\n        #[arg(long)]\n        fix: bool,\n\n        /// Skip chat backend connectivity test\n        #[arg(long)]\n        skip_backend_test: bool,\n\n        /// Output results as JSON\n        #[arg(long)]\n        json: bool,\n    },\n\n    /// Generate self-signed TLS certificate for development/testing\n    GenerateCert {\n        /// Domain name for the certificate (default: localhost)\n        #[arg(default_value = \"localhost\")]\n        domain: String,\n\n        /// Certificate validity period in days (default: 365)\n        #[arg(short, long, default_value = \"365\")]\n        days: u32,\n    },\n\n    /// Validate TLS
